subject: Post-signature MAP: staged cutover, canary & evaluation cadence for OrbitWorks
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@orbitworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature MAP: kickoff & first-pass timeline (onramp/canary/eval)

Hi Sarah —

Congrats again on signing. Attaching a first-pass MAP spreadsheet (OW_MAP_v1.xlsx) that embeds the implementation plan, including:

- Week-by-week rollout windows
- Canary windows and success criteria
- Migration cutover tasks and owners
- Training schedule (admin + user sessions)
- Evaluation plan: prompt sets, pass/fail metrics, and regression triggers

Quick asks so we can lock dates:
1) Confirm preferred canary week (we suggested Aug 31–Sep 6).
2) Which team should we include on the training invites (names + roles)?
3) Procurement contact for invoicing and the PO timeline.

We propose a three-week canary (three small waves) before full cutover, with an evaluation sweep after each wave. If that works, we’ll draft the mutual sign-off section in the MAP.

Attachments: OW_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with embedded plan), canary_checklist_v2.pdf (checklist).

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: kickoff & first-pass timeline (onramp/canary/eval)

Alex —

Thanks, and the MAP looks thorough. High level:
- Canary window preference: we prefer Sep 6–12 for the first small wave (gives us two weeks to prep).
- Training: please include two product owners (myself and Joe Turner, CTO) and our platform ops lead (procurement@orbitworks.com will route to the right ops person).
- Procurement: procurement@orbitworks.com is the correct inbox; they’ll need the final MAP + SOW to generate a PO (target: Sep 1).

Couple of notes on evaluation: we want accuracy checks on our top-20 intents (we’ll share the list by EOD Wed) and a manual review process for the first two days of each canary wave.

—Sarah

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: kickoff & first-pass timeline (onramp/canary/eval)

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the detail. I updated the MAP (see OW_MAP_v1.xlsx tab "Committed Plan") to reflect:

- Canary Wave 1: Sep 06–12 (sandbox -> 50 users)
- Canary Wave 2: Sep 20–26 (expanded to 200 users)
- Full cutover: Oct 04 (production routing, rollback window Oct 04–10)
- Eval gates: automated precision/recall checks on top-20 intents after 24h; manual review on days 1–2 (ops + CS).

We added owners for each migration task and a simple gating rubric (pass = <2% intent drift + latency within SLA). If a gate fails, we have automatic fallback to the compatibility model (same API surface, lower-cost weights) and a rollback runbook in the checklist.

Next steps:
- Sarah / Joe: confirm the training participant list (names and emails) by Fri Aug 14.
- Procurement: if you can share the PO ETA by Sep 1, we’ll queue the Dedicated capacity reservation for Sep.
- Monica / Jonas: please validate the canary monitoring hooks (token-level cost alerts + per-route latency SLOs) and confirm retention window for debug logs.

Forwarding OW_MAP_v1.xlsx + canary_checklist_v2.pdf + eval_prompt_set.csv.

Subject: Internal: OrbitWorks MAP — action items before Sep 6 canary

Team — quick internal note as we lock this down:

Action list (owner / ETA):
- Monica: finalize training deck (admin + end-user flows). Deliverable: training slides + recording by Aug 24.
- Jonas: ensure monitoring hooks (per-route latency, token cost, regression alert) are instrumented in staging by Aug 28. Confirm retention policy for debug traces (suggest 30 days).
- Laura: generate the canary runbook for support rotations and escalation ladder; include DocuSign link for MAP sign-off. Due Aug 25.
- Alex: coordinate PO intake and confirm Dedicated capacity reservation; I'll follow up with procurement@orbitworks.com.

Keep items tight — we have two prep weeks before Wave 1. If we hit any friction on the eval prompt set from OrbitWorks, we’ll prioritize a short manual review sprint to avoid delays.

Thanks — Alex
